Patterns available in this theme. Copy the ones you need and delete the rest.
Leading underscore in the filename keeps this file out of the rendered site.

Slide classes:
  {.center}   centre the slide vertically, title included (reveal's own)
  {.tcenter}  centre the text horizontally
  {.smaller}  shrink the type on a dense slide (Quarto's own)

Every image needs fig-alt saying what it shows (WCAG 1.1.1, and it is what
the tagged-PDF deck uses too). Photos in raw HTML need alt="..." instead.
-->
